texts: The two barred Keepers often neglected the Stilllight Station.

fields.sentence: The two barred Keepers often neglected the Stilllight Station.

q1_issues.issue: A counted definite plural with a distributive predicate must keep the group-level event alongside the per-member rule (Cardinality: 'keeps the group + count + group event ... and adds the per-member rule', per the 'Both dogs barked' example), but no group-level neglect event is emitted.

q2_gaps: a capitalized plural kind-word label carrying a cardinal and an adjectival modifier ('the two barred Keepers') — the instruction set gives no test for when such a plural is 'referring as a name' (Name-only individual, no GroupOf) versus an ordinary capitalized common-noun plural, unlike the mechanical test it supplies for the capitalized singular case

a frequency adverb ('often') on a definite-group distribution rule — the frequency dial sets 'the rule's strength', but that rule's strength is already the universal-distribution quantity, so the instruction set does not say how quantification over occasions and quantification over members combine on one atom
review.notes: Name handling of 'the Stilllight Station' (opaque symbol + Name + separate kind atom) follows the Kestrel River pattern exactly, and 'barred' correctly distributes to members rather than riding the group symbol.

issues.reason: Cardinality states that a plural with a distributive predicate keeps the group + count + group event and ADDS the per-member rule (the 'Both dogs barked' example emits both), and Quantifiers repeats that Cardinality 'keeps the group event + count alongside the rule' — the group-level neglect event is simply absent here.

gaps_confirmed: a capitalized plural kind-word label carrying a cardinal and a modifier ('the two barred Keepers') has no mechanical name-vs-common-noun test, unlike the capitalized singular case
a frequency adverb over a definite-group distribution rule: the frequency dial and the universal-distribution quantity both claim the same rule-strength slot
new_gaps: the mandated group-level event under a frequency adverb has no stated strength or bundling form — the dial sets 'the rule's (or, for a flat generic, the statement's) strength', but a positive multi-atom group event is emitted as separate atoms with no convention for carrying a non-default 0.8 across them
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form adds the group-level event beside the per-member rule — (Member sk_neglect_1 neglect) (Agent sk_neglect_1 sk_group_1) (Theme sk_neglect_1 stilllight_station) (Past sk_neglect_1) — exactly as 'Both dogs barked' emits the group bark event alongside its per-member rule.
adjudication.notes: Everything else is doctrinal: 'barred' distributes to the members rather than riding the group symbol, Stilllight Station follows the Kestrel River name/kind split, and the 0.8 strength plus the 'often' companion match the frequency dial.
